title: Ranking objective and exposure diversity (static preferences)
purpose: Estimate how each ranking objective changes exposure diversity relative to random with matched candidate pools
primary_outcome: final-window normalised exposure topic entropy H_exp
primary_contrast: content similarity minus random (paired by seed)
planned_analysis: paired t and bootstrap over 10 seeds; Holm over secondary contrasts

title: Ranking objective and simulated preference reinforcement (drifting preferences)
purpose: Estimate how each ranking objective changes preference concentration under an explicit drift rule
primary_contrast: content similarity minus random (paired by seed)
planned_analysis: paired t and bootstrap over 10 seeds; drift-form sensitivity

title: Sensitivity of the primary contrast to pool skew and choice sharpness
purpose: Test whether the EXP-001 interpretation survives a skewed catalog and a flatter choice curve
primary_outcome: final-window normalised exposure topic entropy H_exp
primary_contrast: content similarity minus random per cell; skew interaction
planned_analysis: paired t within cells; Welch interval for skew interaction
